messages.subject: [šiht] cepiva in modeliranje
parts:
Če te zanima delo v R-ju v zvezi z v zadevi omenjenimi temami, je spodnji razpis mogoče za té.

http://www.jobs.ac.uk/job/BEA929/senior-r-developer-data-scientist-technical-support/

We are seeking a motivated Senior R Developer to assist with the development of open-source packages for collecting and analysing vaccine impact simulations contributed by 10+ modelling groups, which are then created into reproducible and auditable reports to communicate the results to the funders, the modellers, and other stakeholders.

lp,
Roman

In God we trust, all others bring data.
